document.title: قانون احکام دائمی برنامه های توسعه کشور

observed_indicators: PDF text header identifies مرکز پژوهش‌ها - طرح‌ها و لوایح
PDF body repeats the rc.majlis.ir source URL
letter number 1054 and date 1396/01/16 appear in the document
letter number 33/96683 and date 1395/12/01 appear in the document
approval in public session on 1395/11/10 is stated in the forwarding letter

bank_collision_screen.scope: exact title and URL checks only; not a full semantic or article-level duplicate determination

selection_rationale: The title is not an exact top-level entry in the current active laws.json.
A source page associated with the Parliament Research Center is identified in the PDF body and repeated as a URL.
The 31-page document is large enough to exercise multi-page extraction while remaining practical for a first controlled test.

The visible text includes nested clauses, notes, inserted provisions, and irregular article numbering, making it useful for testing legal-structure parsing without treating parser output as authoritative.
known_risks_and_open_checks: The official rc.majlis.ir endpoint returned HTTP 502 in the Phase 6.1 web check; live official retrieval remains unconfirmed.
The FAOLEX PDF is a mirror and must not be substituted as the official acquisition source under the project source policy.
The visible text has numbering and layout irregularities; article boundaries and inserted provisions require page-by-page comparison against the original PDF.
The document's current amendment, repeal, and enforceability status has not been established in Phase 6.1.
No PDF was downloaded into the project, no SHA-256 was assigned, and no ingestion or active-bank write was performed.

phase6_1_decision.next_action: Phase 6.2 must acquire the PDF from the allowlisted official Parliament source, or stop and report source unavailability; the mirror may be used only for discovery comparison, not as a substitute source.
